label: Bearer of some occurring thought episode
term: bearer of an occurring thought (thinker) in the #1791 fork
definition: Thinks Occurs Bears x holds exactly when some episode e satisfies Occurs e and Bears x e: x bears at least one occurring thought episode. Occurs is not world-indexed, so Thinks x by itself does not say that x exists at, or is concrete at, the selected world, and NecessaryAt of a thinker does not say that it thinks at every accessible world. No unity, persistence or personal identity of the bearer is implied.
note: Analyst reconstruction for #1743/#1791, reusing the Cogito primitives Occurs (DEF c0cbef1c, occurrence of a thought episode) and Bears (DEF ce8ccc1a, subject of a thought episode). Example: an episode e with Occurs e and Bears b e makes b a thinker; a being that bears only non-occurring episodes is not one. Actuality comes only from the separate EveryBearerExistsAt and EveryBearerIsConcrete bridges.
